market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a former governor of the province (2018-2022) and a major figure in the Democratic Party. With the 2026 local election shaping up as a referendum on the unpopular Yoon administration, the Democratic candidate has a strong chance. The market's 0.8% implied probability greatly underestimates his odds, given he hasn't ruled out running and would be a frontrunner if he does.
evidence_points: Yang Seung-jo previously won the governorship with 59.5% in 2018 and remains a recognized name.
Current national political headwinds favor the opposition Democratic Party heading into the 2026 local elections.
The market price implies a near-zero chance, which is inconsistent with him being a plausible major-party nominee.
sources_consulted: South Korean National Election Commission historical results
News archives on Yang Seung-jo's political career
General knowledge of South Korean political dynamics
